sloka: तत्र मे याचितः राजा भरतस्य अभिषेचनम् ।गमनम् दण्डक अरण्ये तव च अद्य एव राघव ॥२-१८-३३॥
transliteration: tatra me yācitaḥ rājā bharatasya abhiṣecanam ।gamanam daṇḍaka araṇye tava ca adya eva rāghava ॥2-18-33॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghus, hence I have asked the king for consecration of Bharata and your departure to Dandaka forest today itself.
